lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately six horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular blobs, creating a structured grid pattern where spots act as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal side and a shadow-defined lower boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible first dorsal fin contains approximately eight distinct high-luminance spots distributed across its lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller, elongated dark silhouettes corresponding to commensal fish (remoras) are visible near the ventral-lateral area.
